# Round 2 fixtures

HTML pages and the known-source inventory used by `tests/round2/run_acceptance.py`
and by a manual `scripts/monitor_tool.py` dry run.

These are not production programs and they are not copied into `site/data/catalog.json`.
The acceptance run writes `acceptance_report.json` and `demo_transcript.txt` here.
Snapshot bodies stay in a temporary directory.
